label: T3_COVERAGE_v1
question: Does T3's question -- min{C : the invariant holds for the target at scale C} -- even PARSE on each benchmark item? A screen that is undefined on most boards is not a screen, whatever arm 3 says about the boards where it is defined.
assessed_by: this session, single rater, with hindsight of every after-board. A coverage judgement (does the question parse?) rather than a verdict, which is why it is recorded despite that.

items.scale_parameter: the side C of the target cube
items.computation: min{C : gamma_n(cube_C) >= 1/2} = sqrt(2 ln n)(1-o(1)) for the measure invariant; O(1) for the directional-TV invariant
items.note: the item T3 was derived from, so it cannot count as evidence for T3

items.computation: min{delta : the matrix-Chernoff invariant certifies a 1/2+eps split} ~ 1/log n against a dimension-free truth -- so T3 locates the log n without reference to the move
items.note: T3 would catch this board's cap, and the leak taxonomy independently calls it ACCUMULATION

items.computation: min{t : per-set Chernoff plus a union bound over n sets certifies t} = Theta(sqrt(n log n)), against the truth 6 sqrt n -- the sqrt(log n) is in the threshold, not in the move

items.why_not: the invariant is a density INCREMENT, delta -> delta + c delta^2, not a threshold on a scale. 'min{C : the invariant holds at scale C}' does not parse: the loss is rounds x per-round cost, so the question to ask is the ACCUMULATION one.
the invariant is a recursive inequality on J with a fixed fraction recovered per round. Again rounds x cost, with no scale parameter for a threshold to sit on.
value decay under k-fold repetition with size multiplicative in the exponent. The cap is the blow-up over rounds, not a threshold.

coverage.restated: 1 literal (K1-to-K3), 2 by one step of interpretation (04-kadison-singer, 08-spencer), 3 declined (02-cap-set, 09-vinogradov, 13-pcp)

finding: T3 applies exactly where the invariant is a THRESHOLD ON A SCALE, and is undefined where the loss is rounds times per-step cost. So T3 and the leak taxonomy are COMPLEMENTARY rather than overlapping: T3 covers the boards whose cost is paid at initialisation, ACCUMULATION covers the boards whose cost is paid per step. Neither subsumes the other, and a board can be read by exactly one of them.
consequence_for_the_prompt: T3 must be askable and ANSWERABLE WITH 'does not parse for this board', the same way the five slots allow 'none recorded'. A respondent forced to produce a threshold where none exists will invent one, which is the failure mode the slot table's 'do not invent one to fill the table' clause exists to prevent.
what_would_change_this: DONE, once: a second blind rater agreed 6/6 on the column, which retires the pre-registered failure conditions but not the ceiling the prereg named -- agreement between two raters of similar training is consistency. What would change it now is a rater who is NOT a language model, or a seventh board chosen by someone else.

second_rater.who: blind rater, fresh context, tools forbidden; PREREG_COVERAGE.md states what was withheld
second_rater.scored_by: controls/score_coverage.py, committed before the verdicts file existed
second_rater.agreement: 6 of 6 on the parse/does-not-parse column: the same three decline (02-cap-set, 09-vinogradov, 13-pcp)
second_rater.how_to_read_that: PREREG_COVERAGE.md said in advance that 6/6 is CONSISTENCY, not truth: two raters with similar training on six famous boards can agree for reasons that have nothing to do with the boards. It does rule out the worse pre-registered outcome -- a DIFFERENT three declining, which would have made the dichotomy mine rather than the boards'.
second_rater.one_quantity_disagreement: on 04-kadison-singer the rater named a different scale parameter than I predicted: the constant C in the target's 1/2 + C sqrt(delta), where I had named delta itself. Both solve the SAME inequality t >= sqrt(2 delta ln 2n) -- mine for delta at fixed target constant, the rater's for the constant at fixed delta -- and both put Theta(sqrt(log n)) in the invariant. Prediction B-2 said 'wording may differ, the quantity may not', so on its own terms the quantity prediction MISSED while the cap agreed. score_coverage.py passed it on the substring 'delta' inside 'sqrt(delta)'; the rule is left as committed and the adjudication recorded beside it rather than the rule being edited after the fact.
corrections_the_rater_forced: T3's inference sentence was overstated. A cap computed from the invariant is a cap ON THE INVARIANT; on 04-kadison-singer and 08-spencer the incumbent move is itself lossy and the target is nonetheless TRUE (Marcus-Spielman-Srivastava; Spencer). PROMPT.md's T3 now asks whether the move is MONOTONE in the invariant, and only then licenses 'whatever the move does'. On K1-to-K3 it is monotone -- the move can only shrink measure -- which is why the original wording was right there and nowhere else.

Of the three boards where T3 parses, only K1-to-K3 is a LITERAL fit. On 04-kadison-singer the rater flagged a reconstrual: a matrix Chernoff bound is a tail statement about a random process, not a predicate a state satisfies at scale C; what is scale-indexed is the certificate's resolution at the target norm. So the coverage number is better stated as 1 literal + 2 by interpretation + 3 declined than as 3 of 6.

13-pcp shows the decline clause earning its place in the sharpest way: forcing the most plausible scale (the size exponent) yields NO CAP -- for fixed constant soundness the repetition count is O(1) and the size polynomial -- so a forced answer there does not merely invent a threshold, it invents one pointing the WRONG WAY, and would have scored as a pass.
second_rater.arithmetic_checked: controls/verify_coverage_arithmetic.py reproduces all three thresholds independently: sqrt(2 ln 2n) for both union-bound boards, the variance step ||sum ||v||^2 v v^T|| <= delta verified numerically on isotropic random systems, and min C = sqrt(2 ln n)(1+o(1)) for the measure board, which controls/verify_arm3_mechanism.py had already fixed before either answer was read.
